about_the_game:
Medieval Sandbox RPG: Weave Your Destiny

『The End of History』 is a sandbox-style strategy RPG set in a medieval-inspired world.

As the protagonist, you leave your foster parent's home one day and embark on a journey as an unknown wanderer.

In a world where the motives of numerous NPCs intertwine, and cooperation and betrayal collide,

you become a part of this world and can live freely as you choose.

Stop the Collapse of the World

Your mission is singular: to stop the collapse of the world. The world is heading towards destruction fueled by rising hatred and division. Every action has consequences, and you must observe their effects carefully.

Live Freely

From being a nameless entity to becoming a thief, trader, knight, or even a king, your existence in the world is up to you. Your choices shape your destiny.

'Obelisk' Mystery

This massive and mysterious structure holds the wisdom of a seemingly infinite world. Its existence is now shrouded in mystery, with fragments scattered across the world to piece together its secrets.

A Unique Story──
This is not a heroic tale, but a record of historical observation.

The aftermath of battles, the words exchanged, the small, forgotten choices──

all of these stir emotions and change actions. NPCs will continue to live their lives without you.

However, your decisions create ripples in their stories.

This game does not depict a predetermined scenario, but a unique and unrepeatable history

born from the player's involvement.

short_description: A Strategy RPG where you live freely in a vast medieval feudal-simulated sandbox. Listen to the requests of the citizens, trade, plunder, serve, own a territory as a noble, usurp the throne, endless wars, and betrayal. The intertwining of your and numerous NPCs' intentions creates unique stories.
